questions.question: Which language should the SPFx web part use?

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript implementation for the SPFx web part.

questions.rationale: Required by the supplied project decision and compatible with the research report's current GA SPFx recommendation.

questions.question: Which UI framework should the web part use?

options.label: React 17 with Fluent UI v9
options.description: Matches SPFx 1.23.2 React guidance and the report's Teams-oriented UI recommendation.

questions.rationale: Grounded in the research report's SPFx 1.23.2 compatibility and component guidance.

questions.question: Which SPFx hosting surfaces should the web part support?

options.label: SharePoint page
options.description: Host through the SharePointWebPart supported host.

options.label: Teams tab
options.description: Host the web part as a TeamsTab.

options.label: Teams personal app
options.description: Host the web part as a TeamsPersonalApp.

questions.rationale: The research report recommends these supportedHosts and the project requests an SPFx path suitable for SharePoint/Teams.

questions.question: Which language should the mock API use?

options.label: C#
options.description: Use ASP.NET Core minimal API in C#.

questions.rationale: C# is the implementation language specified by the ASP.NET Core minimal API requirement.

questions.question: Which ASP.NET Core API style should be used?

options.label: ASP.NET Core Minimal API
options.description: A small .NET 10 project exposing a mocked streaming endpoint.

questions.rationale: The requested implementation is explicitly an ASP.NET Core minimal API.

questions.question: Which streaming protocol should the mock endpoint use?

options.label: Server-Sent Events
options.description: Return text/event-stream chunks with native .NET 10 SSE support when available.

questions.rationale: SSE is the requested streaming response type and is documented in the supplied report.

sharedQuestions.question: Which data stores or storage services are required?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The endpoint returns fixed mocked sample data and this project has no persistence.

sharedQuestions.rationale: The sample data is mocked and no database or file storage is specified.

sharedQuestions.question: Should users sign in to access protected application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Acquire an Entra access token and protect the mock API with delegated authentication.

sharedQuestions.rationale: The requirement explicitly calls for SPFx Entra token acquisition and an Entra-protected custom API call.
